name: The Missing Diplomat
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You say Elling sent you here? Well then, the hospitality I expressed is now tenfold. Anything you need, just ask. I will do my best to aid you.

Hmm, Slim, you say? Not sure the name sounds familiar, but I'll keep my eyes out for him.

Don't look now, adventurer, but the gentleman over by the exit is looking over here. He's listening to our conversation a little too intently if you catch my meaning? If I were you, I'd do what you can to subdue him before he makes a break for the door.
narrative.objectives: Subdue Tapoke Jahn before he escapes, and then return to Mikhail in Menethil.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Caught him, huh? Good for you. I'm surprised that was Slim.

I'll be honest, I never thought I'd miss the excitement of some of the more devious underground activities. I guess old habits die hard. Don't mention that to Elling--he'd probably try and get me to come back to Stormwind if he heard I missed the action.

I'm glad I could at least be of a little service to you while you were in Menethil. If you need anything else, just ask.
narrative.requestItemsText: Did he slip away? He looked a little shady the way he was watching us.
